about_the_game:
RaceOnLife: Open-world racing MMORPG

Welcome to Solanos, an island full of freedom, where laws don't apply to everyone, and power belongs to those who grip the wheel the tightest.

Solanos lives its own life: cities and suburbs, underground arenas, dark docks and gangster neighborhoods where only the crazy survive.

You arrive on an island and from that moment on your life becomes a high-stakes game. Assemble a team, expand your influence, defend your territories and lay claim to others. You must earn respect by participating in street races and fights.

They remember what you did

The world operates by its own rules. NPCs here are not just "puppets," but part of the game ecosystem. You will have to interact with them, which will influence the further course of the game.

Each NPC has:

  • Status, habits, routes, and relationships with other NPCs

  • Their own emotions, intelligence, and memory

  • Public discontent indicator

  • Profession, hobbies, and role in the game world

  • Remembers your decisions and actions, which affects the life of the city

For example, if you say nasty things or do horrible things, NPCs will react and spread it to other NPCs, as well as telling other players, which will make the game more difficult to complete. Conversely, if you do any good deeds, you will receive numerous benefits.

Modes

The game features permanent game modes: races, underground fights, and derbies, as well as various seasonal events. Here you can not only hone your skills but also place bets and earn in-game currency.

🏎 Racing: In this mode, you can compete on the track or organize real street races against other players in destructible cars and motorcycles.

👊 Underground Fights: You will have to fight dozens of cunning opponents to reach the final level, your endurance and agility are the keys to the highest reward.

💥 Derby: metal meets madness, in this mode survival is the only goal, save your car by fighting to the last one standing.

Play to Risk

Every decision is irreversible, you don’t have a “replay” button, only consequences!

As a player, you can bet on seasonal events, races, underground fights, and derby matches. Wins and losses have a significant impact on your assets, but the risk is worth it and gives you the opportunity to earn more.

PVPE

  • PvE: complete missions, daily quests, participate in racing events and the fighting arena

  • PvP: street fights, clan races, territory battles, duels with other racers

Main rule: There are no rules!

“Drive or Die”

💬 Message from us

We strive to improve the game with your feedback. We value constructive criticism; your input helps us grow and improve everyone's gaming experience. Don't hesitate to contact us, we welcome every feedback and comment!

content_descriptors.notes:
While our game is all about fun, freedom, and connecting with others, we also give players the ability to fully express themselves - sometimes with their fists. Fights can happen both in dedicated combat modes and across the open-world map, with visible blood and realistic action.

We do not encourage violence and strongly promote respectful, friendly gameplay. Still, the freedom we offer may lead to unpredictable - and sometimes intense - situations. Enjoy the chaos responsibly, and remember: the real win is making new allies, not enemies.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 470 or NVIDIA GTX 780
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5500XT or NVIDIA GTX 1660
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended

short_description: RaceOnLife: MMORPG about street racing, fighting, and power in an open world where everyone has their own path. Create your own band, expand your holdings, compete in game modes, and play solo or with friends. This is not just racing - it is life at speed with complete freedom of action!
